'''Choza Raabat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] until he was stranded in the depths of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] after his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crashed in a scouting mission. Raabat survived for ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before he encountered a patrol ship from the [[Eternal Empire]], which he was forced to commandeer and use to escape after they opened fire on him. Raabat returned to find the galaxy under the control of the Eternal Empire, and worked with the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] to free [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] from their control.

==Biography==
An [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Choza Raabat served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Raabat embarked on a scouting mission to [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], but he barely survived a crash on an uninhabited and uncharted [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that destroyed his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]]. Raabat was marooned on that world for an entire [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]], surviving alone until [[3633 BBY]] when a patrol ship from the [[Eternal Empire]] of the planet Zakuul set down to survey the world. The crew opened fire on the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] when he introduced himself and requested rescue, forcing Raabat to incapacitate them and commandeer their vessel. Interrogating his prisoners, Raabat learned of the Eternal Empire's [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of the galaxy and returned to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], where he found planets such as [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] under the control of massive [[Star Fortress]]es. Together with [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], the leader of an [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the Eternal Empire, Raabat rallied some of the local nobility and destroyed the shield bunker protecting the Star Fortress, and formally joined the Alliance after the destruction of the [[Alderaan Star Fortress]].<ref name="Resistance" />

==Behind the scenes==
Choza Raabat was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], as the local contact for Alderaan in the Star Fortress series of missions.<ref name="Resistance" />
